Gate risk-control is validated on this market (gate_helps=true), and the 7-call track record is perfect but statistically trivial.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: The strongest eligible combination of durability (0.81, highest among eligible themes) and trend health (hurst_tag='trend', breadth=1.0) with a middling momentum score (0.555, rank 5). This fits a defensive, yield-seeking HK market where the trend-gate is the one validated discipline and this theme has the cleanest staying-power profile. Crowding z is flat (-0.05), so no size-down caution applies.
